notes.title: Garshasp: The Monster Slayer Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Garshasp: The Monster Slayer have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

- Added Russian language support
- Added Polish language support

notes.title: Release date set.
notes.notes: We are glad to announce the release date on steam. May 9th. Looking forward to this exciting day!
